title: Portfolio Site
summary: Personal portfolio and admin portal built with Next.js 14, Firebase, and Tailwind CSS.
problem: Needed a fast, SEO-friendly portfolio that could be managed from a private admin portal without a CMS.
solution: Static-exported Next.js app with Firebase Auth, Firestore, and a portal-protected admin UI.

title: GPS Tracking Infrastructure
summary: Real-time GPS tracking platform for fleet management built on Node.js, gRPC, and cloud infrastructure.
problem: Existing fleet tracking solutions lacked real-time accuracy and couldn't scale to thousands of simultaneous vehicles.
solution: Built a custom gRPC-based backend with real-time position streaming, map rendering, and alerting pipelines.

title: Audio Fingerprinting Pipeline
summary: Automated audio fingerprinting and content recognition pipeline for media rights detection.
problem: Manual audio content matching was too slow and error-prone at scale for a media company.
solution: Built a pipeline using audio fingerprinting algorithms, FFT processing, and distributed job queues.

title: Treasury Dashboard — First Republic Bank
summary: Internal treasury and cash management dashboard with real-time data sync and reporting.
problem: Treasury teams relied on manual spreadsheets and disconnected tools for cash position tracking.
solution: Built a React/Node.js dashboard with live data feeds, automated reconciliation, and drill-down reporting.

title: Data Migration Platform — JPMorgan Chase
summary: Enterprise data migration framework for moving legacy financial data into modern cloud systems.
problem: Legacy system migrations at scale involved complex transformations, compliance requirements, and zero-downtime constraints.
solution: Designed and built a configurable migration engine with validation pipelines, audit trails, and rollback support.
